title: Restriction coordinates of a discrete coefficient section
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring in universe $u$ and $\Lambda=\mathrm{discreteObj}(A)$ [def-sfb-integral-models-stacks-data]. Let $Y$ be a scheme and $U$ an object of its coefficient-sized pro-etale site [def-sfb-affine-locally-constructible-proetale-modules]. For a global section $x:\mathbf{1}\to\Lambda_{U.left}$, there is a section $s$ at $U$ of the constant commutative ring sheaf with value $\operatorname{ULift} A$ on this site. For every $g:V\to U$ and $c\in\operatorname{ULift} A$ whose image under the constant-presheaf sheafification unit equals $s|_V$, the canonical inverse image of $x$, namely $\epsilon_{g^*}\,g^*(x)\,\alpha_g$, equals $\epsilon_{p_V^*}\,p_V^*(\delta(c))$. Here $\alpha_g:g^*\Lambda_{U.left}\to\Lambda_{V.left}$ is the canonical condensed coefficient map, and $\delta(c)$ is the explicit point unit-section: apply the sheafification unit at the one-point profinite set to $c$, take the additive map from the lifted integers sending $1$ to that element, then use the constant-sheaf adjunction and its monoidal unit. No cover, finite tuple, module arrow or matrix is asserted.

source.place: Tag 03CY, lemma-sheafification-presheaf-modules; literature/stacks-project/sites.tex, Tag 00YV, proposition-functoriality-algebraic-structures-topoi. The scalar section identification in step 1 of lem-sfb-discrete-internal-matrix-local-lifting.

proof.text: Form coefficientAbIso by composing the comparison forgetting commutative rings to abelian groups, constantSchemeIso, and the inverse point comparison. The constant-sheaf adjunction and the lifted-integer corepresentability of the underlying-group functor give unitSectionEquiv. No object is selected from an existence statement.

Apply pushforwardContinuousSheafificationCompatibility to composition with U.hom and to AsSmall.down. Both functors are continuous and cocontinuous. Evaluating the resulting isomorphisms at the identity object gives coordinateEquiv, an explicit equivalence between small-site coordinates and unit sections of the discrete coefficient on U.left. The sheafification unit laws show that a constant coordinate c maps to constantScalarSection.

The private general constantScheme_pushforward lemma in FiniteDiscreteCoefficientTerminal applies to any abelian coefficient M, any condensed abelian sheaf R, and any comparison from the point constant sheaf. A natural transformation from a constant presheaf is determined at a terminal object. Extend that terminal identity to a full presheaf identity, and take its mate under localizationRestrictionLowerStarAdjunction. Sheafification uniqueness then proves coefficientAbIso_localization.

The counit formula for unitSectionEquiv proves its compatibility with restriction along every continuous site functor. Prove composition compatibility for the constant-sheaf comparisons using sheafify_hom_ext and their unit equations. Apply this to the three over-map functors associated to V to U to Y. Together with the monoidal upperStarIsoSheafPushforward and the coefficient localization square, this proves schemeCoordinate_naturality. Naturality of the AsSmall comparison gives coordinateEquiv_naturality.

Take s = coordinateEquiv.symm x. Rewrite its restriction using coordinateEquiv_naturality and the hypothesis on c. The constant-sheaf adjunction, naturality of constantSchemeIso, and its monoidal unit law identify constantScalarSection with epsilon_p followed by p applied to discretePointScalarSection. This gives exactly the stated equality. All constructions work for empty schemes and the zero ring.

theorem discrete_section_coordinates
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (U : Scheme.coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, u} Y)
    (x : 𝟙_ (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (AsSmall.down.obj U).left) Ab.{u + 1}) ⟶
      condensedRingObj (discreteObj A) (AsSmall.down.obj U).left) :
    ∃ s : ((constantSheaf (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, u} Y)
        CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} A))).obj.obj (op U),
      ∀ (V : Scheme.coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, u} Y) (g : V ⟶ U)
        (c : ULift.{u + 1} A),
        (toSheafify (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, u} Y)
          ((Functor.const (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, u} Y)ᵒᵖ).obj
            (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} A)))).app (op V) c =
          ((constantSheaf (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, u} Y)
            CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} A))).obj.map g.op s →
        Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (AsSmall.down.map g).left) ≫
            (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (AsSmall.down.map g).left).map x ≫
            condensedPullbackHom (discreteObj A) (AsSmall.down.map g).left =
          Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε (upperStarFromPoint (AsSmall.down.obj V).left) ≫
            (upperStarFromPoint (AsSmall.down.obj V).left).map
              (discretePointScalarSection A c)
